note: Capture for the KamAZ-4310, the Soviet 6x6 cargo truck built 1981 to 2001. Every value is grade claimed from a tier-5 compilation. The entry binds no game class: the installed content that carries the maker name states 'KAMAZ' and no model, so no class text names the 4310. data/vehicle/MODDED_CLASS_GAPS.md records that finding. The capture holds one entry and the retired capture-level sources array stays empty. The wheelbase row is not carried: the source publishes the front-to-bogie distance and the bogie spacing as one '3190+1320' expression, which is not the single front-to-rear-axle distance the field means.
